Rajgir Solo Travel Guide: ₹500/Day Challenge? Low Budget Hotels, Night Safety & Street Food Tips
Namaste Doston! (Hello friends!) Welcome to my ultimate Rajgir solo travel guide for the budget-conscious backpacker. If you're planning a trip to Bihar and wondering how to manage a spiritual journey or a casual trip under a tight budget (specifically ₹500 a day!), this vlog is for you!
In this night walk, I'm taking you through the glowing streets of Rajgir and sharing my absolute best low-cost solo travel tips that every vlogger and independent traveler needs to know.
